notes.title: Pumpkin Smasher VR - Update V2.6
notes.notes:
[h1]Pumpkin Smasher VR - Haptics and More Action - Update V2.6[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35909212/8363db5c1e29b5ae0d09e72da0c028e7558aa3f2.png[/img]
This release includes haptics so you can feel the pumpkins smash, acceleration and variation in pumpkin delivery, and other improvements.

[b]Version V2.6 Summary:[/b]
[list]
[*] Controller Haptics when Smashing Pumpkins
[*] More variation in Flying Pumpkins movement
[*] Faster delivery of Pumpkins on conveyor belt
[*] Faster Flying Pumpkins
[*] Limiting damage from Hanging Bats and Black Cats
[*] Start changes and keyboard commands
[*] Experimental Free Movement and Snap Turn ("F" & "T")
[/list]
